```{r}
# importing relevant libraries
library(ggplot2)

```

1.   **Grouped Bar chart function**

```{r}
# Grouped bar chart function
grouped_bar <- function(df = NULL, x_var = NULL,y_var = NULL, category =NULL){
  figx <- ggplot(
    data = df,
    aes( x = .data[[x_var]],y = .data[[y_var]], fill = .data[[category]])
    )+
    geom_col(
      position = "dodge",
      width = 0.5
    )+
    geom_text(
      aes(label = paste0(.data[[y_var]],"%")),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
      vjust= -0.4
    )+
    labs(
      title = paste("Distribution of",x_var),
      subtitle = paste('Distribution stratified by',category),
      x = tools::toTitleCase(x_var),
      y = tools::toTitleCase(y_var),
      caption = "Source: SambugAnalytics"
    )+
    theme_bw()+
     theme(
    text = element_text(family = "serif",size =13),# global text style
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold",hjust = 0), 
    axis.title.x = element_text(size =11, face = "bold"),# styles only x axis title
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold",size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
  return (figx)
}
```

2.  **Simple Bar chart Function using tidy eval :**.

```{r}
# let's write another simple function for barchart
simple_bar <- function(df = NULL, x_var = NULL){
  figsimp <- ggplot(
    data = df,
    aes(x = {{x_var}})
  )+ geom_bar(
    fill = "lightblue",
    width = 0.5
  )+
    geom_text(
      stat = "count",
      aes(label = after_stat(count)), # this is the internal count geom_bar does
      vjust = -0.4
    )+
    labs(
      title = paste("Distribution of participants by",deparse(substitute(x_var))),
      x = tools::toTitleCase(deparse(substitute(x_var))),
      y = "Count",
      caption = "Source : SambugAnalytics"
    )+
    theme_bw()+
      theme(
    text = element_text(family = "serif",size =13),# global text style
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold",hjust = 0), 
    axis.title.x = element_text(size =11, face = "bold"),# styles only x axis title
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold",size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
  return (figsimp)
    
}
```

3.  **Box plot Function**

```{r}
# function for creating basic boxplot
simple_boxplot <- function(df = NULL, x_var = NULL, y_var = NULL, comp =NULL, anot= NULL){
 figbox<- ggplot(
    data = df,
    aes( x = {{xvar}}, y = {{y_var}})
  )+
    geom_boxplot(
      fill = "white",
      staplewidth = 0.5,
      median.linewidth = 1,
       alpha =1,
    color = 'black',
    linewidth= 1,
    coef = 1.5,
    outlier.color = 'black',
    outlier.size = 1.5
    )+
    geom_signif(
      comparisons = comp,
      annotations = anot,
      y_position = max({{y_var}})+10 # needs modification
      )+
   labs(
    title = paste("comparison of",deparse(substitute(x_var)),"across",deparse(substitute(y_var))),
    caption = "Source:SambugAnalytics",
    x = deparse(substitue(x_var)),
    y = deparse(substitue(y_var))
  )
   
    return (figbox)
}
```

4.  **Histogram plot function**

```{r}
hist_plot <- function(df, x_var, fill_var, plt_title){

  x_var_name <- deparse(substitute(x_var))
  fill_var_name <- deparse(substitute(fill_var))

  histfig <- ggplot(
    data = df,
    aes(x = .data[[x_var_name]])
  ) +
    geom_histogram(
      aes(fill = factor(.data[[fill_var_name]])),
      binwidth = (max(df[[x_var_name]], na.rm = TRUE) - 
                  min(df[[x_var_name]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 30,
      color = "white"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(
        min(df[[x_var_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
        max(df[[x_var_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
        by = (max(df[[x_var_name]], na.rm = TRUE) - 
              min(df[[x_var_name]], na.rm = TRUE)) / 30
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = plt_title,
      caption = "Source: SambugAnalytics"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "serif", size = 13),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

  return(histfig)
}
```
